root_cause.text: In the `eip93_unregister_algs()` function, the hash algorithm unregistration incorrectly uses the function parameter `i` instead of the loop index `j`, causing the same algorithm at index `i` to be unregistered repeatedly during driver detach, leading to a kernel panic.
root_cause.evidence: The patch changes `crypto_unregister_ahash(&eip93_algs[i]->alg.ahash)` to `crypto_unregister_ahash(&eip93_algs[j]->alg.ahash)` inside the `case EIP93_ALG_TYPE_HASH:` block, fixing the variable reference from the outer parameter to the loop iterator. The CVE description confirms the bug is due to a wrong iterator causing duplicate unregistration.
